summary.en: Use history to understand naming and compatibility rather than rank eras.
summary.zh-cn: 通过历史理解名称与兼容性，不把年代当作优劣排名。

boundary.en: New formats and architectures coexist with older systems. A film-era reference in a name does not make actual formats identical.
boundary.zh-cn: 新画幅和结构会与旧系统共存，名称沿用胶片时代的参照不表示实际规格完全相同。
